# Contract: react-best-practices

## Purpose
Apply Vercel's React and Next.js performance rules when writing or refactoring React code.

## Use it for
- "this React page is doing too much waiting"
- "check this Next.js code for performance rules"

## Not for
- how the page should look (glyph)
- a guidelines audit of UI code (web-design-guidelines)
- a measured benchmark (benchmark-honestly)

## Accepted inputs
React or Next.js code the user owns.

## Deliverables
Code changes or a review grounded in the bundled rules.
